title: Chapter 1: Taking out the Trash
brief: The Akadian campaign has begun. General Durand has placed the Akadian army's brightest young recruit, Lieutenant Hayne, in charge of the forces on the battlefield. Akadians's mission begins slowly; someone needs to clean up the confused remnants of the Northern Federation forces.

do.message: It is a glorious morning, Lieutenant Hayne. Today you begin the conquest of the Northern Federation.
It is my great honor... and may I say that you could not have picked a more suitable commander for your army.
Clean up this riff-raff that Captain Tucker left behind. It's embarrassing to even look at their bumbling.
My battlecruiser and tanks will make short work of them, sir.
Make me proud, Lieutenant. It took me a great many years to set us up for this assault; I won't see it squandered.

Squandered? By me? Sir, I am the result of generations of glorious Akadian breeding! There is no one better suited to this task in all of the Akadian people, present company excluded, of course. Now... all units, engage the Federation!
Is this a joke? This should have been like using a rocket to swat a fly. You are a disgrace, Hayne.
This is the best the Federation has?
These forces were weak, and Captain Tucker was not there to lead them.
Tucker will meet the same fate as the rest.

You forget, Lieutenant, that I spent a good deal of time in the Federation. For years I was part of Tucker's battalion, and I know his tactics well.  The Northern Federation on the whole is undisciplined... but Tucker is a fierce enemy.
When I am finished with him, he won't even be able to remember his own name.
I have a mission for you, Lieutenant. I have gotten word from our advance scouts that the Northern Federation has developed a new type of military base -  a mobile structure.
I will seek out these units and destroy them, sir. Our engineers will be able to piece together the wreckage to unravel the technology used to craft them. This new weapon will be mine... erm... ours!
One more thing. I will be sending my nephew with you. He needs some time away from me... once and for all...
Sir?
To see the world, of course. He needs to get out and see the world.

title: Chapter 2: Mayjor Upset
brief: Lieutenant Hayne must track down this mysterious new unit that the Northern Federation has in its arsenal, the War Machine. His plan is to simply track the retreating Federation troops, but the problem with following an army is that they will try and slow you down. The Federation deploys a rear guard battalion in an attempt to slow Akadians's advance.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Uncle told me you were the best! He lied to me.
Or maybe... maybe he meant that I'm the best! Wooo! I'm the best!
Sir! Reporting for duty!
Who are you?
Major Mayjor, sir! General Durand instructed that I am to report to you for personal tutelage!
Major Mayjor? Is this a prank? Am I getting punked?
I don't think so, sir. Did you want to be? Was that an order? Is that my first order?!
I always thought the General liked me.
He must! I'm his favorite nephew!
Aren't you his only nephew?
Maybe.
Major, this is a relatively small force. I want you to use the long-range Rocket Trucks supported by the Stealth Tanks. Just try not to destroy my beautiful tanks.
No promises, sir!
I can't believe I did it! I won! I won everything! I'm a legend! Uncle Durand will be so proud!
Let's not be hasty. I am the master tactician and commander here. I have guided you to victory.
But you didn't DO anything.
It's leadership by osmosis. You benefit because I'm here. Very complicated. You wouldn't understand.
Whatever. I'm the best! Everyone will love me now!
That glory is mine!
I touched it last.
Ah! What is this? A Federation contingent up ahead? Soon, this new Federation toy will be the latest weapon in the my...erm... in the Akadian arsenal.

title: Chapter 3: The War Machine
brief: Lieutenant Hayne's scouts report discovering a strange radar signature; it must be the mysterious War Machine! It is protected behind a sturdy Barricade, but even a massive defensive structure like that cannot stand up to a focused strike. Akadians plans to claim the War Machine intact... but the Federation isn't prepared to let him have the device that easily.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Detonate the charges!
We can't let Hayne get his hands on the Warmachine.
Hayne has failed me. Get me another commander... one less incompetent this time, please.
What is that thing?
That, Major, is the War Machine. General Durand has ordered that we obtain its technology for the glory of the Akadian army.
How are we supposed to capture that? It's like a city! It's huge!
Just watch me carefully and I'll show you how a true warrior gets the job done.
And so modest, too.
Is he the new guy? Oh, he's dreamy.
Tucker! How nice of you to arrive in time for a crushing defeat. I was afraid you would simply spend all your time running from my awesome might.
Uncle says Tucker is dangerous.
Hush, Major. Watch and learn.
Cowards!
What just happened? Are they even allowed to do that? Weren't you supposed to be teaching me how to do something?
They detonated the unit, rather than see it fall into our hands. Where are you Tucker, you coward?! Where did he go? Off hiding in some cave?
I demand a do-over! DO-OVER!
Major, I have a very important task for you.
Ooh! What is it?
The engineers have quite a lot of work ahead of them sifting through the rubble for the parts they need. They can't be left unprotected.
But what are you going to do?
I mean to find Captain Tucker, and grind him into dust.

title: Chapter 4: Two-Faced
brief: Lieutenant Hayne receives an urgent communiqué from the Major, who reports that large contingents of Northern Federation troops are showing up on his radar scanners. This wouldn't be so strange normally, but Mayjor is located well behind the Akadian front lines, and there doesn't appear to be any way the Federation could have snuck the volume of units he is detecting behind their lines.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Lieutenant, the only reason I have not had you executed already is that your past victories have bought you my patience. You disgrace the uniform.
Save me! The Federation is everywhere! It's Tucker, he's here! It's an ambush!
Tucker! Thought you could pull off a sneak attack against the finest fighting force this world has ever seen? Led by its finest commander, I might add.
I actually hadn't planned on running into the Major, no. But I think we can make this work, too.
I'm glad you can be so light-hearted about your impending defeat.
I never take war lightly. Speaking of, Durand couldn't be bothered to come down and deal with me himself?
The General has seen fit to send the pride of Akadia to squash you like a bug.
I'll give you one chance, Hayne. Stop following that mad man and join us. He's not the great leader that you think he is.
I hope you didn't really think that that would work. The General led me to believe you were better than this.
Now Major, how could they manage to get such a large force behind our lines so quickly without you noticing? Didn't you see the convoys approaching?
There was no convoy. All of a sudden they were everywhere. It was the War Machine! That's how they got here!
What exactly does this War Machine do?
It poops tanks!
The ore deposits! We have razed their cities... but not their mining centers. The War Machines tap into the deposits and use them to manufacture units. It's brilliant.
Dibs on the War Machine!
Are you serious?
Dibs.
Rock-paper-scissors.
Oh, it's ON.
You blew them all up again.
It's hard to be very precise with the enormous power of Akadian armor. I am not accustomed to capturing units.
I've got another special assignment, don't I?
Very perceptive.
I'll start sifting through the trash.

I'm recalling the main force; we need to strike at the center of these War Machine units, especially with Tucker still commanding them. He's clearly a coward, but he is elusive. It's time for a major offensive.
You mean a Mayjor offensive? I'm in charge!
No. Not Mayjor. Major.
Yes! Major Mayjor's major offensive! Score!
Just... just shut up.

title: Chapter 5: N. Federationed Out
brief: Now that Lieutenant Hayne has seen the War Machine in action, he knows how imperative it is to claim the technology for the Akadian army. The War Machines he has destroyed so far, though, have not yielded enough functional components for the engineers. Lieutenant Hayne prepares to launch himself into the belly of the beast.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: I thought he was supposed to be the big Akadian tough guy? Man, whatever to that.
Back for more, eh?
I defeated you before, and I will do so again.
I never was very good at keeping track of the score.
Will you surrender the War Machines to me, or do I have to beat you until you cry for your mother?
Are you for real? Who talks like that?
Who talks like that? I am the most decorated commander in Akadian history... for my age. They call me the Akadian Avenger, the Terror of the Battlefield, the Northern Federation Nemesis...
Hey now. Let's not be too hasty about this battle thing. I was just... ummm... you have a... wonderful speaking voice.
If you want the War Machine, you'll have to come take it. Unless you're afraid you can't handle the firepower.
...pssst... stop making him angry!
We are going to crush you all. There will be parades in our honor! We'll be heroes! And you, Tucker, you'll be dead.
You're good, Hayne. It's too bad you can't see the General for what he is.
What do you know of the General? He is a hero and he crushed your forces after making a fool of you.
I'd love to stay and educate you on what we've learned about your General Durand since he betrayed us, but elaborate military plans call.
Stand and fight, coward!
Can't. We've got haircuts later.
Lieutenant! Uncle Durand is on comms. There's a vein popping out of his forehead.
It's time for us to begin basking in the glow of our glory, Major.
Hello, sir! We have defeated the Federation once again and the engineers should now have enough parts to reconstruct and produce the War Machine. Akadia forever!
War Machine? Who cares about the War Machine anymore? We have something much more pressing to deal with, Lieutenant. The Dragoons have returned.
Dragons?!
The Dragoons... all these years later. They've finally returned to finish what they started.
Scales and wings and claws and fire! We're doomed!
Shut up, nephew! Clearly, the Dragoons want the chance to finally destroy the Akadian people. You must stop them.
I will, sir. I have a score to settle with the Dragoons. My father was killed during the raid that sparked off the Dragoon War.
If they have joined forces with Captain Tucker, this is a dangerous combination. We have no idea what sorts of weaponry that the Dragoons will be bringing with them.
Whatever they may have... it will not be enough.
What can we use to defeat dragons?! Unicorns! We'll ride unicorns into battle. Unicorns with laser missiles strapped to their backs!
Mayjor, get a hold of yourself and  gather the forces. The Dragoons must be approaching over the Nithenian Sea. We strike at the Federation shipyards immediately!

title: Chapter 6: Skeletons in the Closet
brief: While the Akadians focused on the War Machine, Dragoons, old enemies of the Akadians, have been joining the Federation from across the Nithenian Sea. Lieutenant Hayne rushes to stop this influx of combatants before the situation spirals even more out of his control. Lucky for him, the first of the Akadian War Machines is ready for the battlefield.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: I could understand losing to actual dragons. Those guys are cool. These guys should have been a piece of cake. Mmmmmm... cake.
The War Machine is ready. Now we'll use the Federation's own weapon against them. It's a shame the Dragoons had to come all this way just to be dashed against the shore.
I don't know how to swim.
Then you'll just have to make sure your ship doesn't sink, won't you?
How nice of you to come greet our guests, Lieutenant.
Tucker. Of course. But it's not very polite of you to invite a guest over just so they can receive a severe beating.
I don't recall inviting YOU anywhere.
Oh snap!
Man the ships, Major. I want you to storm across that water and seize these shores. I'm tired of hearing Tucker and his crony mock us in spite of their failures.
So, those weren't dragons, those were Dragoons. I feel cheated.
What was that strange unit?
That was the Jammer Truck.
Were you planning on joining this fight anytime soon, Dragoon?
Not before having a chance to study my enemy.
And what have learned, watching from your little truck?
That you are skillful, aggressive and headstrong, just as Captain Tucker has said.
You should leave here, Dragoon. There is nothing but destruction for you here.
Not so. We have come here for our vengeance.
Vengeance?! You started the Dragoon War with your raids on Akadia. We were allies!
How interesting. The victors truly do write the history books.
And soon they will write about how the great Lieutenant Hayne drove the Dragoon menace from Akadian shores once and for all!
We will meet again, Lieutenant.
Arrogant old man! We need to know what that Jammer Truck is capable of! Send out an infiltration team, I want a report of its capabilities immediately!

title: Chapter 7: Here be Dragoons
brief: Lieutenant Hayne desperately needs to staunch the flow of new Dragoon forces onto the mainland. It's time for Akadians to pay a visit the Federation's shipyards. The Dragoon Jammer Truck could present a serious problem for Akadians's long range and stealth units, both the pride of the Akadian military.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Isn't there anyone competent other than me in this army?
This report is worrying.
What does it say?

The Jammer Truck is an electronics disruption unit. The infiltration team reports that the truck will prevent aerial units from flying within its range and it will even counteract the cloaking ability of our stealth tanks. This is disastrous!
Won't this be a great time for you to show me what a wonderful soldier you are? I even brought a notepad so I could take notes!
How about I show you the back of my hand?
But... I did bring a notepad! It's right here! I drew a picture of you riding a tank on it!

Focus, Major. This is a major naval center for the Federation. We must annihilate all Federation presence here. They cannot be allowed to continue bringing Dragoon forces onto the mainland. Strike fast! No prisoners!

Victory! With this naval center demolished, the Federation's ability to bring in further Dragoon support is crippled. It should be a simple matter for the vast Akadian army to clean up the remnants. I must contact the General to report our success.
Yes, Lieutenant?
The Federation shipyards are no more, sir. The flow of Dragoons should now be a trickle. The crisis is averted once again by my magnificence.
Return to rejoin the main force. Then we will sweep across the land and purge our enemies from it.
Yes, sir. We'll return right away.
Buck, buck, buck, bakaw!
What are you doing Argent?
That's my chicken sound. No good?
Leaving so soon, Hayne? Probably for the best. I'll be sort of a legend in the Federation for constantly outwitting and escaping from the Akadian Bumbler, Lieutenant Hayne.
Ridiculous! I am the finest military mind of this generation! I have beaten your forces again and again. You are no match for me.
And here you are, returning home like a good little boy, tail between your legs.
I have my orders!
Exactly. Durand knows that you can't hack it out here anymore. He knows I've been saving my best forces and he knows that you can't measure up.
Mayjor, gather the troops. We advance on the position of Captain Tucker's radio broadcast.
But it's an island fortress! And it's a trap. He wants you to disobey orders. Even I know that, and I'm an idiot!
I don't care. The world will know that no one can defeat me.

title: Chapter 8: Snapshot
brief: Akadians is getting closer and closer to his goal. The Dragoon forces are being directed outward from an island near the now-destroyed shipyards. Akadians must crush this vital control center for the invasion in an attempt to break the organized resistance he's facing.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: I've failed. Could it be that I'm not the best, after all?
Uncle Durand keeps trying to radio us. He wants to know how we're progressing on the return trip.
We have a battle to attend to.
But it's such a bad idea!
Then you need to do your absolute best if you don't want to get blown up, won't you?
I guess.

Focus the assault on overtaking the Federation resources. They'll overpower us with reinforcements if we cannot claim control. If we can shut down that factory, it's just a matter of time before Tucker falls before our superior weaponry.
Do you see, Tucker? No one can defeat me. Not you, not your Dragoon friends. No one!
And you still can't catch me. Not everyone is very good at finishing what they start. It's okay.
Uh-oh! Bad habit!
That's no good.
Shall we head to our secret forest base now?
After you, good sir.
Fools! I will crush you once and for all!

title: Chapter 9: Rift
brief: Lieutenant Hayne may have managed to secure the outer borders of the mainland for now, but he knows that the forces have moved inland and he means to track them to their center of operations. Scouts have found Dragoon forces entering into nearby forest, no doubt attempting to mask their forces under the cover of the trees.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Hmm. So I'm supposed to follow Hayne's example? Maybe Uncle wants me to go crazy and disobey orders, leading to my eventual defeat as well...
Lieutenant Hayne! What is the meaning of this?
I am completing my mission, sir.
Your mission is complete. Your orders were to return to rejoin my forces.
I have unfinished business here. Captain Tucker and the Dragoons remain a threat.
A threat I will deal with! And that is why your orders are to return to base immediately!
I'm sorry, General. Your transmission is breaking up.
I'll have you drummed out for this, Hayne! This is treas...
You hung up on him!
Not another word from you, Major. Prepare the troops.
I know they help us move through the mountains... but the Spider Tanks have always creeped me out. I mean, are they poisonous, too? No one will tell me.
Did you see him? He's like a crazy animal out there.
I saw.
Are you sure this is still a good idea?
Captain Tucker has a sound plan. He has studied his enemy. It will succeed.
Why am I always the bait?

title: Chapter 10: Backdraft
brief: Lieutenant Hayne commences his final assault to crush his opposition. Their central force is gathered here and a successful strike should cripple their operation for good. Akadians has fully committed his forces to this battle... but isn't being this focused on a goal what got them into this mess in the first place?
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: We were so close. And I hear every time someone fails a mission, a kitten gets punched in the face. Good job with that, Hayne. A kitten got punched because of you.
Tucker. This is the end of the line. Your troops have no other locations to run to. No other places to hide. Soon, you will finally have to admit who the superior warrior is.
I'm sorry, were you looking for Tucker here? No one here but us Dragoons. And me.
Don't lie to me. This is one of Tucker's tricks. Come out and fight me!
Today we will see how you fare against me.
Is he too much of a coward? Fine. All units, attack!
Victory! The Dragoons are no match for the power of Hayne! I am unstoppable! Crawl away, Captain Argent and tell that coward Tucker that I've crushed the best he had to offer me.
There's a radio transmission coming through!
The General. He won't be able to punish us after he hears of our triumph here today.
Hayne! Our forces are under attack! It was a trap, you idiot.
Told you so.
What are you talking about? I've destroyed their forces. Their base is in ruins around me. Akadia reigns supreme!
They've been baiting you! They lured you as far away from my forces as they could and then they sprang their trap. Tucker has us surrounded on all sides! I'm ordering a full retreat to Akadia!
But... but... I won! I beat them!
You've doomed us, Hayne! They split our forces. We're outmaneuvered and outgunned now!
I think you were saying something funny about my crawling away in defeat?
You! You'll pay for this you smart-mouthed weasel!
Sticks and stones, sticks and stones.
We have to get back and save Uncle!
We will return to Akadia to defend her from our enemies... as soon as I destroy this little weakling.
Let's do this!
Keep the Lieutenant occupied, Captain Argent. Dragoons! We rally to join Captain Tucker's forces in assaulting Akadia! The time of our vengeance is at hand!
